title: A path with a message
hook: Some animal signals can persist on a surface.

knows: Animals can send and receive signals.
doesNotKnow: Describe a simplified role of chemical trail signals in some ants.

objective: Describe a simplified role of chemical trail signals in some ants.

claims.text: Some animal signals can persist on a surface. In the model, an ant leaves a chemical trail and a second ant detects it. What can the trail help communicate? The schematic represents a chemical trail on a path to food. In many ant species, trail pheromones can help other ants follow a route. The diagram is a simplified example; a single trail does not convey every detail of a colony.

claims.text: The stage uses a simplified, not-to-scale schematic and stated model assumptions; it is not a photographic observation of an individual animal.
Recall: An ant follows a trail pheromone left on a surface. What kind of signal is it detecting? Trail pheromones are chemical signals.
